checkpoints.title: Copilot route in the model layer: CopilotCLI runs gemini-4-argon at high effort, CopilotRouted picks it for the ui-review lane's copilot row, CopilotReady checks copilot is installed and signed in, and the reported AI credits are the call's cost
contracts: models.CopilotRoute and models.CopilotCLI (prompt on stdin, minimal environment, COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN only)
Gateway.Do resolves the copilot ui-review row with Resolve; every other call keeps ResolveDirect
registry: the copilot ui-review row is Gemini 4 Argon (high), Alternative gemini-3.8-flash (high)
an unmetered call is charged upper-bound tokens priced by Cost
instrumentation: each call is a model.call action with via copilot, cost_usd and cost_source reported, and the breaker counts it
checkpoints.rollback: revert the PR; or a person sets [models.ui-review.copilot] model = "" in their user config to use gemini-3.8-flash through the gateway

checkpoints.title: The reviewer behind review lane A, polish and verify's look tries the Copilot route first and falls back to gemini-3.8-flash (high), saying so on stderr and in the label; it never skips the review
contracts: Env.reviewer: CheckFamilies on the Copilot model, CopilotReady before any call, ValidReply on each reply, fallback for that call and every later one, ErrBudget still stops
instrumentation: stderr line and lane label naming why Argon did not run

checkpoints.title: Config: [models.ui-review.copilot] is read only from the user config or --set, and model = "" on that row turns the route off
contracts: config.Load rejects models.ui-review.copilot from the repo and local layers (never from the checkout)
config validation allows an empty model on the ui-review lane's copilot row only
